build_audiodec_codec: build an AudioDec codec instance with custom tx and rx devices and receptive length
build_audiodec_streamer: build an AudioDecStreamer for real-time audio encoding and decoding with custom audio devices
run_assign_model: run assign_model to get sample rate and checkpoint paths for a pretrained model like vctk_v1
review_audiodec_load_encoder: review the AudioDec class _load_encoder method to understand how symAudioDec checkpoints are loaded
review_audiodec_load_decoder: review the AudioDec class _load_decoder method to understand how symAudioDec or HiFiGAN decoders are loaded
